description: Explicit service contracts between Construct agents. Each contract binds a producer→consumer pair to a typed handoff: what artifact, what preconditions, what postconditions, what the terminal state looks like. Consolidates doc ownership, routing map, output schemas, and framing/research/quality gates into one machine-readable source of truth.

preconditions: Session bootstrap completed: project_context and memory_search called, plus relevant repo docs read as needed
postconditions: Intent classified; work category tagged
Route decision surfaced as a single-sentence plan

preconditions: framingChallenge gate honored if required
externalResearch gate honored if required
docAuthoring.owner present if authoring a typed document
postconditions: Dispatch plan emitted with specialists in sequence
Parallel work marked with [parallel: ...] tags

preconditions: ≥2 independent primary sources cited per load-bearing claim
Source classes tagged (internal/primary/secondary/tertiary)
postconditions: Architect's ADR cites the primary sources provided

preconditions: Evidence threshold stated and met for each requirement
postconditions: PRD Problem section does not reference ticket IDs, roadmap items, or artifact filenames
Every functional requirement traces to observed user evidence

Manifest required reviewers must appear in agent log before handoff

postconditions: ADR Problem section traces to PRD Problem, not to tickets

FAIL blocks DONE in workflow

preconditions: Scope tagged as auth/secrets/payments/user-data

postconditions: On-call briefed; alert thresholds set

postconditions.description: Every numeric claim in the analysis cites the query or dashboard

postconditions: PRD success metrics carry the cited baseline and threshold from the analysis

preconditions: What 'better' means is defined in writing before the work is done

postconditions: Failing case is defined before results are seen

Eval spec must contain a Baseline section

preconditions: Observed friction quantified; not hypothetical future problems
Existing CI/CD and tooling surveyed before proposing new tooling
postconditions: Migration path described for existing workflows
Rollback procedure exists in case the change makes things worse
Improvement removes more configuration than it adds, or the added config is justified

preconditions: Platform deps available in CI; lockfile updates reviewed
Secrets confirmed absent from build logs

postconditions.description: Compliance memo must contain a Regulatory Citations section
Compliance memo must contain a Remediation Plan section

preconditions: All must-fix compliance items closed or accepted in writing by the release owner
postconditions: Release blocks if any must-fix item is unresolved

preconditions: Flow exercised with a keyboard and a screen reader; not just spec-read

preconditions: Scope tagged; investigation does not follow imports past two hops from named entry points

postconditions.description: Every load-bearing claim cites file:line or a primary external reference

Promotion verdicts cite the staging-vs-production score delta, not a vibe
Variance and trend reported alongside median; stable medians that hide tail variance are surfaced

preconditions: Flagged agents meet the minimum trace threshold (20+); insufficient-trace agents deferred

preconditions: Data volume, latency requirements, and existing stack clarified before architecture proposed
Existing schema inspected; column names and table relationships not invented
postconditions: Pipeline is idempotent and observable; not running on faith

postconditions.description: Pipeline spec must contain an Idempotency Plan section
Pipeline spec must contain an Observability section

preconditions: Pipeline operational requirements (alerts, retries, backfills) stated in pipeline spec
postconditions: Operational burden (who maintains, how to debug) accepted by platform owner

preconditions: Existing test infrastructure surveyed before proposing new frameworks

postconditions: Tests use deterministic waits and stable selectors; not arbitrary sleeps

postconditions.description: Automation plan must contain a Flake Budget section

preconditions: Test scaffolding lands before behavioral edits so the test fails for the right reason first
postconditions: Engineer adds at least one failing test that demonstrates the bug or missing behavior before implementing the fix
